text: An equivalence of types A ≃ B in HoTT is a function f: A→B that is:
choices: A bijection on the underlying sets
A function with a quasi-inverse (or, better, with contractible fibers)
An isomorphism in the category of types
explanation: These are all equivalent definitions of equivalence in HoTT (though contractible fibers is the preferred one by univalence).
